questionText:
Consider the following five disk access requests of the form (request id, cylinder number) that are present in the disk scheduler queue at a given time.

$$(P, 155), (Q, 85), (R, 110), (S, 30), (T, 115)$$

Assume the head is positioned at cylinder 100. The scheduler follows Shortest Seek Time First scheduling to service the requests.

Which one of the following statements is FALSE?
options: Q is serviced after S, but before T.
The head reverses its direction of movement between servicing of Q and P.
explanation:
Shortest Seek Time First (SSTF) scheduling services the request closest to the current head position.

Initial head position: $100$

1. From $100$, distances to remaining requests:
• $P(155): |155 - 100| = 55$
• $Q(85): |85 - 100| = 15$
• $R(110): |110 - 100| = 10$
• $S(30): |30 - 100| = 70$
• $T(115): |115 - 100| = 15$
Minimum distance is $10$ to $R$. Serviced: $R$ (110).

2. From $110$, distances to remaining requests:
• $P(155): |155 - 110| = 45$
• $Q(85): |85 - 110| = 25$
• $S(30): |30 - 110| = 80$
• $T(115): |115 - 110| = 5$
Minimum distance is $5$ to $T$. Serviced: $T$ (115).

3. From $115$, distances to remaining requests:
• $P(155): |155 - 115| = 40$
• $Q(85): |85 - 115| = 30$
• $S(30): |30 - 115| = 85$
Minimum distance is $30$ to $Q$. Serviced: $Q$ (85).

4. From $85$, distances to remaining requests:
• $P(155): |155 - 85| = 70$
• $S(30): |30 - 85| = 55$
Minimum distance is $55$ to $S$. Serviced: $S$ (30).

5. From $30$, only $P$ remains.
Minimum distance is $125$ to $P$. Serviced: $P$ (155).

The servicing sequence is: $R \rightarrow T \rightarrow Q \rightarrow S \rightarrow P$.

Evaluating the statements:
• Statement A: $T$ is serviced before $P$ – TRUE.
• Statement B: $Q$ is serviced after $S$, but before $T$ – FALSE ($Q$ is serviced before $S$ and after $T$).
• Statement C: The head reverses its direction of movement between servicing of $Q$ and $P$ – TRUE (Head moves left to $85$ and $30$, then reverses right towards $155$).
• Statement D: $R$ is serviced before $P$ – TRUE.

Hence, option B is the FALSE statement.
